name: @pipeworx/mcp-password

tools.name: check_password
tools.description: Analyze a password's strength offline (keyless): character-set entropy, a strength rating, estimated crack time (offline fast + online throttled attacker), and specific weaknesses (length, missing character classes, sequences/repeats, common passwords). The password is NOT transmitted or stored — analysis is in-process. Heuristic, not a guarantee.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-password forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the password pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
